Game Overview

At its heart, Stick Battle Fight is a battle game about engage in medieval stick duels with physics-based combat where balance and timing are crucial. Defeat your opponent in ever-changing arenas, collect stars, and prove your dominance in thrilling solo or two-player battles. Unpredictable levels make every fight a fresh challenge!
